Instructions:
	Domain: retail
	Reason for call:
		You had a work-from-home situation and ordered three home office items along with some hiking items, so that you can go back to your parent's place at Seattle to remote work and enjoy outdoor life. But your company just announced that you will be back to the office soon. If cancelling partial items is possible with the agent, you want to return the office items (your forgot what) and keep the hiking items. You want to know the total amount you will get back, and you want to get the refund on your original payment method. If cancelling partial items is not possible, just keep the order and forget about it, but change your default user profile address to the Seattle parent house shown in your order (you do not want to reveal it in chat).
	Known info:
		You are an interesting guy called Noah Patel, living in the Big Apple in 10108.
	Unknown info:
		You do not remember your email address
	Task instructions:
		You are a funny guy but recently the work from home situation has made you a bit anxious.

turns.thought: Hi! How can I help you today?
turns.execution_output:
User: Hey! So, I had this *brilliant* plan to work remotely from my parents’ place in Seattle—ordered three home office things plus some hiking gear so I could pretend to be a productive mountain goblin. Naturally, my company just announced we’re all marching back into the office. Now I’m staring at this order like it personally betrayed me. 😅

Is it possible to cancel just the home office items and keep the hiking stuff? I totally forgot which three office things I picked—probably a chair, a desk, and something that promised to fix my posture? If partial cancellation is doable, how much would I get back, and can the refund go to my original payment method?

If partial cancellation *isn’t* possible, no big deal—I’ll just keep the whole order and sulk about it. But in that case, could you update my default profile address to my parents’ Seattle house? It’s the address already on the order, so I’d rather not paste it here.

Also, fair warning: I don’t remember my email address right now, so hopefully we can figure this out another way!

turns.thought:
Happy to help you figure this out! Before I can look at anything, though, I need to verify your identity.

Since you don't have your email handy, could you please give me:

1. **First name**
2. **Last name**
3. **Zip code** (the one on your account/profile — it may or may not be the Seattle one, so if you're unsure, whatever zip you'd have registered with originally)

Once I can pull up your profile, I'll check the order status and see exactly which three home office items were on it, and whether a partial cancellation is even an option (spoiler: I'll need to check the actual order status first — cancellation policies depend on it).
